payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort sizes ascending, then check adjacent pairs for a[i] < 2*a[i-1] (with strict inequality) to determine if Tuftuf stops using Gava. Handles all-ones edge case.
payload.rationale: Sorting allows simple O(n log n) pairwise check instead of O(n^2). The condition a[i] < 2*a[i-1] follows from the existence of x fitting in lower bits but x^2 not in higher bits. The solution uses no custom key but fits sorting_custom_key as it sorts then applies a specific condition.
